US Embassy emphasizes fair trade deal talks with India

The US Embassy in India has stated its focus on negotiating a fair and reciprocal trade agreement that benefits both the United States and India. This comes as US trade chief Jamieson Greer is set to visit India, with both sides reportedly aiming to finalize an interim trade deal. The discussions aim to open markets for American exporters and ensure mutual advantages.
